commonIssues.title: Common Issues
items: File not found - Check the path in your config
Not a function - Make sure you export default a function
Import errors - Use ES6 imports, not CommonJS

proTips.title: Tips
tips: Keep it Simple - Don't overcomplicate setup
Log Progress - Help debug when things go wrong
Handle Errors - Fail gracefully with clear messages
Fast Setup - Don't slow down test starts
TypeScript - Use .ts files with proper typing for a better development experience
